signs.9,5: THISTLEDOWN|Market every day except when it rains, or when it is sunny.
signs.25,7: EAST CAVE|Beware of the logs. They are not just logs.
signs.21,6: MEADOW RUINS|Keep out. By order of Chancellor Vex.
signs.36,6: REEDWATER POOL|No swimming. No fishing. No asking why.

talk: pendant_ruins1
You found the Pendant of Valor! I knew you had it in you.
Two more Pendants are hidden across Varrowmere. One, they say, lies beneath Reedwater.
Find them before Vex does.
Wren! You look like you slept in a hedge.
East of here, past the cave, the old Meadow Ruins sit behind the gate.
Vex has soldiers guarding it. Cut the bushes for hearts, and mind the logs.
Fresh goods! Prices go up every time you look at them. That is just how markets work.
Energy drinks? Sold out. Some fellow bought forty and ran off to train in the woods.
They say a shrine sits at the bottom of this pool.
My grandmother swore the water drops when the old sluice upstream is shut.
Me? I just rent out the boat. Well, I would, if anyone had stolen it back for me.
Three days I have been fishing here.
So far: one boot, one cart wheel and somebody's crumpled receipt for a plushie.
Those logs in the east meadow are not logs.
I sat on one. Spent a week in hospital. The nurse said it happens more than you would think.
pendant_ruins1
Still no orders to open the north road.
I have asked for a raise twice. They gave me two more nerve and a pat on the head.
Come back with a second one of those shiny Pendants and maybe I will forget I saw you.
The north road is closed by order of the Chancellor.
Do not ask me why. I just stand here. The pay is terrible.
Two Pendants! Right, I never saw you. The road north goes up to Cinderfold.
If anyone asks, you overpowered me. Make it sound heroic.

signs.8,2: A note pinned to the shelf from Captain Brannoc:|'Back late. Don't touch my blade. And feed the pigeon.'

signs.14,11: Scratched into the rock:|"The wall to the east sounds hollow."

signs.22,16: Carved in the stone:|'The meadow's valor sleeps behind three locks.'

signs.9,4: SLUICE GATE|Property of the Chancellor's Waterworks.|Do not touch the lever. We mean it. Probably.

signs.20,24: Water stains climb to the ceiling.|Somewhere in here, the old priests could raise and lower the water at will.

signs.6,20: CINDERFOLD|Miners welcome. Soldiers tolerated. Tax collectors pushed down the well.
signs.26,6: EMBER FORGE|Property of the Chancellor. Hot. Do not lick.
signs.26,20: OVERLOOK|East, past the mountains, the towers of Ashford Castle. West, a cow. Mostly the castle.

talk: pendant_forge
Three Pendants! The Dawnblade sleeps in the old grove east of Ashford.
Take it, child, and end Vex's rule.
The forge up the mountain has burned for a hundred years. Vex's men keep it lit day and night.
They say the third Pendant, the Pendant of Embers, sits in its heart.
Mountain prices, friend. Everything costs more up here. The air is thinner and so is my patience.
I used to mine up there. Then the Gilded Hand moved in and the pay went to ten cash a day and a free hospital visit.
Mostly the hospital visit.
The Wisps in the forge? Your blade passes right through them while they blaze.
Wait until they dim, or shoot them. Fire will not hurt fire, of course.

signs.25,25: The heat is unbearable. Somewhere far above, hammers ring.

signs.4,9: DAWN GROVE|Here rests the Dawnblade, for the one who carries all three Pendants.

talk: Oh, another one. Sit still, this will sting.
There. Good as new. Try not to get thrown through any more windows.
Vex hides behind his magic. Nothing you swing at him will land...
...except his own spells. Strike his orbs back at him with your blade.
He may hit them back. Keep returning them.
